draft_text: Under 10% label noise, Thornbill-NER's F1 dropped by only 0.6 points, within the pre-specified robustness criterion.
rationale: The package only reports original-label results (T1) and seed spread; there is no noise perturbation experiment, no 10% condition, and no 0.6-point drop. The cited T2.r1 does not exist in the package. No defensible narrower version remains.
